Hi everyone,

As you can see I'm not dead. Not everything went exactly as planned and it took me longer to get back to AVE.

For this first update in a long time I concentrated mainly on fixing bugs. But I did add a new feature, since it was really easy to write it.

 New feature

  • Domain filter: works like the other two filter modules. One detail, be aware that if your filter is "abc" the module cannot see the difference between abc.com and abc.def.com. In short it doesn't differentiate between domains and subdomains.

Do you think it would be a good idea to add an option to automatically filter a domain by clicking a cross next to it?

Additions

  • InjectCustomStyle:

    • Added option to inject an external style without removing the original subverse's custom style.
    • Added option to inject the external style after the subverse's custom style.

  • ToggleCustomStyle: this module will now start when InjectCustomStyle is enabled but RemoveSubverseStyle is set to false. This means that you can choose for some subverses to have both external and custom styles enabled, and not for others.

  • InjectCustomStyle & ToggleCustomStyle:

    • Thanks to a fix by /u/FuzzyWords these modules will now identify custom styles way faster

  • Shortkeys:

    • When pressing X to collapse a media the page will now scroll up just above the submission title if the view was too far down.

Fixes:

  • FixExpandImage: added back CSS fixes. Sorry about this mess, there are still issues with this but I think we are converging toward a good compromise.

  • Initialization: AVE will now stop loading modules only if the page's title is exactly that of error pages. Beware: choosing an error message as the title of a subverse would be a very efficient way of disabling AVE.

  • UserTag: fixed bug where the vote balance would be updated for the first username found in the self-text, in the case of submission made in anonymous subverses.

  • AppendQuote & ReplyWithQuote: didn't work anymore because a DOM id has changed and needed to be updated in the code.

  • ToggleMedia & NeverEndingVoat: fixed bug where media in new pages weren't expanded but those already expanded were toggled off and then on again.

  • UserInfoFixedPost: to reduce bugs and improve compatibility with custom styles the user block is now set once regardless of any scrolling done by the user.

As always, don't hesitate to tell me if something I added/modified isn't exactly how you want it.

Finally, I guess it is way too late to thank /u/Mick and /u/FuzzyWords for their help, I'm really sorry they left. So I wanna take this opportunity to thank you all, you are as much working on AVE as me when you find bugs and suggest new ideas. Thank you!
